sentences.japanese: 何本か花がある。一本は赤、もう一本は白で、その他は黄だ。
sentences.english: There are several flowers. One is red, another is white, and the others are yellow.

sentences.japanese: 朝晩だんだん冷えてきました。やがて木の葉も赤や黄に変わることでしょう。
sentences.english: It is getting colder and colder morning and evening. The leaves of trees will soon turn red or yellow.

sentences.japanese: みかんばっかり食べたせいで手が黄ばんだ。
sentences.english: I ate so many mandarins that my hands were stained yellow.

sentences.japanese: 信号機は「赤・黄・青」の3色です。
sentences.english: Traffic lights have three colours: red, amber and green.
